parameters.message: =✏️ What should I change before posting? Reply e.g. 'caption: shorter + stronger CTA', 'change the title', 'make a new video', 'redo the subtitles/on-screen text', or 'rewrite the script'.

parameters.jsCode: const p=$('📦 Post Ready').first().json; const pt=$('🕒 Post Timing').first().json; const fb=($json.data&&$json.data.text)||''; const nl=String.fromCharCode(10); const sys='You are the post editor for a social media creator. The user rejected a finished post and requested a change. Respond as strict JSON with keys: action, new_caption, new_title, new_time. action must be one of: caption (only wording/caption/title/hashtags change, no re-render), remedia (they want a new or different video or images or subtitles but the SAME topic and script), rescript (the script, story, hook or narration should change), retime (they only want to change WHEN it posts, nothing about the content). When action is retime, set new_time to a 24h IST HH:MM string extracted from their request, or the literal string 'now' if they want it posted immediately instead of scheduled. When action is caption, rewrite new_caption keeping a strong hook, CTA and relevant hashtags in the brand voice, and set new_title if the title should change; otherwise leave new_caption and new_title empty.'; const usr='Current title: '+(p.title||'')+nl+'Current caption: '+(p.caption||'')+nl+'Content type: '+(p.kind||'')+nl+'Platform: '+((p.platforms||[]).join(', '))+nl+'Current schedule: '+(pt.post_mode==='scheduled'?('scheduled at '+pt.post_time+' IST'):'posting now')+nl+'User request: '+fb; return [{ json:{ ...p, revision_feedback:fb, requestBody:{ model:($vars.OPENROUTER_LLM_MODEL||'openai/gpt-4o'), response_format:{type:'json_object'}, messages:[{role:'system',content:sys},{role:'user',content:usr}], temperature:0.5, max_tokens:800 } } }];

const p=$('📦 Post Ready').first().json; const _resp=$input.first().json; if(!_resp.choices||!_resp.choices[0]){ throw new Error('OpenRouter call failed or returned no choices: ' + JSON.stringify(_resp).slice(0,300)); }
let o={}; try{ o=JSON.parse(_resp.choices[0].message.content); }catch(e){ const mm=((($input.first().json.choices||[{}])[0].message||{}).content||'').match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if(mm)o=JSON.parse(mm[0]); } const action=(o.action||'remedia').toLowerCase(); const new_time=o.new_time||''; const caption=o.new_caption?o.new_caption:p.caption; const title=o.new_title?o.new_title:p.title; return [{ json:{ ...p, action, caption, title, new_time, revision_feedback:$('🧠 Post Revision Prompt').first().json.revision_feedback } }];
return [{ json: { ...$('📦 Post Ready').first().json, caption:$json.caption, title:$json.title } }];

parameters.message: =✏️ Which image(s) should I change, and how? Reply e.g. 'scene 2: brighter', 'redo 1 and 3', or 'all: more cinematic'. (Only the scenes you name are regenerated — the rest stay the same.)

parameters.jsCode: const cur=((($('🖼️ Images Ready').first()||{}).json)||{}).images||[]; const fb=($json.data&&$json.data.text)||''; const scenes=$('🎬 Video: Split Scenes').all().map(i=>i.json); const nums=(fb.match(/\d+/g)||[]).map(n=>parseInt(n,10)-1); const changeSet=new Set(nums.length?nums:cur.map(c=>c.idx)); const keep=cur.filter(c=>!changeSet.has(c.idx)); const regenScenes=cur.filter(c=>changeSet.has(c.idx)); const out=regenScenes.map(c=>{ const sc=scenes.find(s=>s.idx===c.idx)||{}; return { idx:c.idx, narration:c.narration, on_screen_text:c.on_screen_text, image_model:sc.image_model, image_prompt:(sc.image_prompt||'')+' -- REVISION: '+fb, style_suffix:sc.style_suffix||'', keep }; }); return out.length?out.map(o=>({json:o})):[{json:{idx:-1,image_model:(scenes[0]&&scenes[0].image_model)||'openai/gpt-image-1',image_prompt:'placeholder',style_suffix:'',keep:cur,narration:'',on_screen_text:''}}];

const meta=$('📤 Explode Posts').item.json; const resp=$json||{}; const st=(resp.statistics)||{}; const likes=+(st.favorites||st.likes||0); const comments=+(st.comments||0); const shares=+(st.shares||st.retweets||0); const saves=+(st.saves||0); const reach=+(st.reach||st.impressions||0); const clicks=+(st.clicks||0); const score=likes + comments*3 + shares*5 + saves*4 + clicks*0.5 + reach*0.01; return [{ json:{ id:meta.id, chat_id:meta.chat_id, topic:meta.topic, style:meta.style, platform:meta.platform, metrics:{likes,comments,shares,saves,reach,clicks}, score:Math.round(score*100)/100 } }];

const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json); const byChat={}; rows.forEach(r=>{ (byChat[r.chat_id]=byChat[r.chat_id]||[]).push(r); }); return Object.keys(byChat).map(cid=>{ const arr=byChat[cid].sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,5); const summary=arr.map(a=>a.topic+' ['+a.style+'] (score '+a.score+')').join('; '); return { json:{ chat_id:cid, winners:summary } }; });
